notes: All latency histograms include BUSY/canceled outcomes; percentiles are power-of-two microsecond bucket upper bounds, not exact order statistics.
One writer and independent reader handles overlap. BUSY is reported, never silently retried without counting. Commit has at most 20 cooperative retries.
Every successful reader checks all rows twice against an exact committed-generation model within one pinned snapshot. Histories are retained only until epoch readers join.
Every epoch joins canceled workers, performs supported normal checkpoint, closes all connections, reopens the same intact database, and checks the exact model.
No fault injection, abrupt process exit with an open database, crash recovery, physical tamper, namespace race, external oracle, or rekey. Ordinary reopen/checkpoint timings are not recovery time.
Encrypted-shared uses a public synthetic fixture key and retains immutable ciphertext history; quota/epoch exhaustion fails the run rather than truncating or calling a shorter run passed.
Windows within a run are correlated. CI bounds are null; independent repeated runs on identical source/workload/hardware conditions are needed before a confidence-qualified regression decision.
All data directories and JSON stdout are retained for investigation. No results are deleted or rewritten by the harness.
